create_orientation.doc: Create an orientation(rotation) value. refobject takes priority over refposition if both are supplied

chance.doc: Percentage chance of condition being checked (condition fails if not)

check.doc: Produce an error message if the provided event object does not exist? Default is true. NOTE: If the event object is a variable or a changeable property, changing it at a later time has no direct effect on this event condition, i.e. it is not re-enabled automatically. It is only updated under certain conditions, e.g. when loading a savegame or when the event condition is restarted explicitly (resetting MD cue or starting AI script).

group.doc: Group of event objects (can be supplied instead of a single event object). The check attribute does not apply. The group is required to exist but may be empty. Adding/removing group members is possible even after the event is set up.

object.doc: Event object (required if group attribute not supplied)

event_object_collected_ware.doc: Event for the specified object collecting a ware drop (object = collecting object, param = ware, param2 = amount, param3 = collected object)

releasesignal.comment: Release signal. List: [param, param2]. Wait will be cancelled if a signal with $releasesignal.{1} as event.param and $releasesignal.{2} as event.param2 is sent to this.object. While event.param MUST be non-null, event.param2 may be null.
releasesignal.name: releasesignal

skipwait.comment: Skip wait. Do not wait for the player
skipwait.name: skipwait

uselaunchtubes.comment: Use launch tubes. Ships in internal storage that undock from a ship with launch tubes are launched from launch tubes. Will be set to false below if container has no launch tubes or ship does not, in fact, launch from a launch tube. Note that this does not assure that ships use launch tubes, but will request their use and involves handling in the script for ships that are launched from launch tubes.
uselaunchtubes.name: uselaunchtubes

checkrelation.default: if ($primarytarget and this.ship.isplayerowned) then this.ship.mayattack.{$primarytarget} else true
